column1: # PROOFS FOR THE ASSERTIONS LISTED BELOW. Not "every assertion in check.py" -- an earlier
# version of this header claimed that and was false: seven assertions had no row at all.
# Claiming coverage you do not have is the defect this whole skill is built against, so the
# scope of this file is now stated as what it is.
# Re-executed 2026-09-02 against the CURRENT tree, in an isolated copy under /tmp holding only
# flow-routing.md, papers-flow.md, index.md and coverage.md -- so that other authors' in-flight
# documents could not colour a result. Every mutation was applied to a SUBJECT (a document, the
# bibliography, the coverage map or the index), never to the guard, and reverted afterwards.
# WHY THE PREVIOUS VERSION OF THIS FILE WAS WRONG, recorded rather than quietly replaced:
#   - it claimed "every assertion"; seven had no row (no bibliography file, missing `type`,
#     bad `status`, `okf_version` outside the index, a `sources` entry with no `id`, a declared
#     source never cited in the body, and the duplication check)
#   - one row's mutation did not produce the output recorded beside it (+250 filler lines was
#     said to give 602 lines; the document is 102 lines, so it gave 352 and did not trip the cap)
#   - rows recorded before a rename still named `papers.md`, a file that no longer exists
#   - the locator row claimed "a citation a reader cannot check" and proved only that a KEY was
#     present -- `locator: ""` passed
#   - the front-matter row claimed the subset was enforced, proved for inline maps only, while
#     inline lists carried the identical unfixed bug
# All of these were found by an adversarial review, not by me.
assertion
column4: observed

column4: references/papers*.md: no bibliography file exists
